mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, the combination signals a supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
